sloka: याते तस्मिन् दशग्रीवे राक्षस्यो विकृताननाः ।सीतां निर्भर्त्सयामासुर्वाक्यैः क्रूरैः सुदारुणैः ।। ५.५८.७९ ।।।।
transliteration: yāte tasmin daśagrīve rākṣasyo vikṛtānanāḥ ।sītāṁ nirbhartsayāmāsurvākyaiḥ krūraiḥ sudāruṇaiḥ ।। 5.58.79 ।।।।

translations.english: When that ten-headed one had gone, the ugly-faced demonesses threatened Sita with cruel and frightful words.
